title: Value Betting
description: There are three different situations with respect to value betting: 1. You Cannot Value Bet 2. It's Optional to Value Bet 3. You Must Value Bet These situations are determined by two key factors: Urgency and Landing Equity. Urgency refers to how important it is to build pot now. Landing Equity is your equity of your hand before your opponent has reacted to your bet.

title: Mental Models
description:
A mental model is an internal explanation of how something works in the real world. It shapes our perceptions, reasoning, and decision-making mechanisms.

By building a 'latticework' of mental models across discipline boundaries—such as inversion, opportunity cost, and first principles—individuals can make clearer, objective assessments of complex problems.
